::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 127,363 people lived in County Waterford, up 9.6% on 2016. It had the 15th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 65% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Waterford was €1,247, the 11th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
